# Harshit Singh — Applied AI Engineer

> Harshit Singh (7harshitsingh) is an IIT Delhi graduate and applied AI engineer focused on production AI systems, agents, language models, and machine learning.

This is a single-page personal website. The homepage contains the public profile, experience, projects, skills, education, links, and any published writing. Writing is read within the homepage; there are no separate article pages.

- [CV](https://7harshitsingh.github.io/Harshit_Singh_IITD_LTFS_AI_Engineer.pdf): Public resume in PDF format.
